author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks I have started a new map - well almost finished. Another very unique Vision. Please tell me what you think. ( walls map ) - Remember no one will get knocked off into the lava ... Knockback will be removed for this map. ( punch, knockback, even normal bow knockback will be removed)

Pics: http://imgur.com/a/3ltsN

First, The map will have all Knockback Removed as this would cause lots of trouble in the world of walls gameplay. The bottom of the map is all lava, 2 reasons, because building in the void is not allowed, a floor of lava allows building, I know Void Building can be allowed, but I want folks to stay on the map. No fire protection on the map. So you fall your out...Next you will see a #$#! load of Chests at the start, these chest are packed with every block type you can think of, Dirt, Clay, Glass, Eggs, Potions, wold spawn eggs ( a few ) bones, bone meal, pistons, redstone, note blocks. on and and on and on. The reason is I want this scary map to be awesomly fun and allow the players creativity. There are enough blocks to completely cover a line from your team to the enemy. No iron ore or bars or diamonds etc in the chests, a few wooden tools and stone ax and pick, in-case someone just wants to start placing blocks... The Iron mine is below, also has cobble,also put in a small forest ( the chest have more than enough wood), and a farm all around the island for food, although animals etc are around.

Diamond are on the map, but are only in the floating smaller islands at different heights... about 50 diamonds in each quad, about 200 iron. - So anyway - tell me what you think!  +1 or -1. If I get enough + Ill finish it.
